questions.question: The architecture's Test section is to link the project's rules for how each kind of part (here, Python code) and the user stories are checked, but no file given for this run, the steering, the README or the plan's files, names such rules. Where are they: a file to link, or none, in which case the architecture's Test section itself says how this tool's code and stories are checked?

questions.question: The architecture's Logical view is to be one figure in an SVG file beside the document, shown in it as an image, but the CCS names only organize-downloads/docs/architecture.md as the work, so the figure's file cannot be written in this run.
